name: devcat-promo
description: README screenshots: capture the demo-mode UI, and turn a demo video into the README GIF.

scripts.stills: mkdir -p ../assets/readme && for f in ai diff table query git k8s network notes agent bots ghost memory welcome; do sips -Z 1600 public/shots/$f.png --out ../assets/readme/$f.png >/dev/null; done
